title: course terms record/1
description: The courses an instructor opened with a term named, in a localStorage key of its own: its version `v` and up to twelve lines, newest first, one per course and term, each the course id (lower-case words joined by hyphens), the term (at most 40 characters), the time and the course title in English and Spanish. js/instructorCourseTerms.js readTerms() is the authority and is lenient: it reads nothing from a record of another version, drops a line that is not the right shape, keeps the first of a course and term that repeat and the first twelve. The schema refuses what the reader drops. FORMATS.md lists it.
